contexts.text: The third (state of regeneration) is a state of repentance. Explained.
That this state is attained on the third day, which = the same as the seventh. Illustrated.
The ternary number = something holy or inviolable as to states.
The third day is received in the Word for the seventh, and involves almost the same, on account of the Lord's resurrection on the third day...
Three, and seven = holy things... They also = what is inviolable, because they are predicated of the Last Judgment, which was to come on the third or the seventh day... AC 901:2, Illustrated.

The third part, like three, = what is holy. The like is involved by the third part as by three; and also by the third part of the third part, as here, for three is the third part of the third part of 27.
Three = what is holy. AC 2109.

Three years old () = all things of the Church as to times and states; for three, in the Word, = a full time of the Church, from its origin to its end, thus all its state; and therefore the last time of the Church is signified by the third day, the third week, the third month, the third year, and the third age.
As the state of the Church is signified by the ternary number, so also is that of everyone who is a Church. Illustrated.
Three = almost the same as seven.
The three men () = the Divine Itself, the Divine Human, and the Holy proceeding; thus the Lord. AC 2329:2. AC 2329:3.
Three measures of meal of fine flour () = the Celestial of His love... Three = holy things. AC 2177:end.
Three tenths. Illustrated.

Such do not diffuse their ideas among Three... Many, when examined there as to what idea they had of the one God: whether three Uncreates; three Infinites; three Eternals; three Omnipotents; three Lords, have been manifestly perceived to have the idea of three Gods...
When the Jews perceive that the ideas of Christians are divided among Three...
Only those in the faith of charity can conjoin the Three separated in idea.
The third day () = the judgment, or the advent of the Lord; thus the approach of His Kingdom.
Hence the Lord's resurrection on the third morning.

On the third day () = what is complete, and the beginning of sanctification... When third is added, it = the end of that state, and the beginning at the same time of the following state. Here, because it treats of the Lord's sanctification, the third day = what is complete, and at the same time the beginning of sanctification; (for) when the Lord had fulfilled all things, He rose again on the third day; for the things which were done or which were to be done, by the Lord... were in the representatives of the Church as if already done... Hence the ternary number was representative, not only in the Ancient and Jewish Churches, but also among various nations. AC 2788:4.
The third day () = the Lord's advent and resurrection. So Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
Three days, and the third day = the same; as also three and the third. Fully illustrated.
A third part, however, = some; and what is not yet complete; but a third and a trine, what is complete; and this, of evil for the evil, and of good for the good.
In three years () = the end of the former Church. Three = what is complete, and a beginning.
Three droves of the flock () = the holy things of Churches and of doctrinal things. Three = what is holy.
Three days journey between () = that their state was completely separated... Three = what is ultimate, and complete, or the end.
With man there are three things in general: the Corporeal, the Natural, and the Rational...
It was told Laban on the third day () = the end; for the third day = what is ultimate, and complete, thus the end, and also the beginning...
On the third day () = what is continuous even to the end; for the third day = what is complete from beginning to end, thus also what is continuous.
Is the Church anything where... Three are equally worshipped? For, although the three are called one, still the thought... makes three...
In about three months () = a new state; for three = what is complete, and thence what is last and at the same time first...
Three shoots () = derivations even to the last. Three = what is complete and continuous even to the end... from first to last. AC 5122.
Three = a whole period and its continuity from beginning to end. Thus the three shoots are three days = the state of the rebirth of this Sensuous from its first to its last. Explained.
In three days () = a new state then; for three = what is continuous even to the end, thus also what is complete; thus three days = a complete state; consequently, after three days = a new state.
Lo three baskets () = the successives of the voluntary things; for three = what is complete and continuous even to the end, thus what is successive. AC 5152. AC 5153.

It came to pass on the third day () = in what is last; for the third day = the last of a state; for the third = what is complete, thus what is last. By the last state is meant the time when the prior state ceases and the new one begins...
Three = what is full.

Three days () = to what is full; for three days = from beginning to end; thus what is full; for it is a new state which is here described. The former entire state is signified by three days, and its last, and thus what is new, by on the third day. AC 5458.
That Peter denied the Lord three times = that (the last state of the Church when there was no longer any charity) was then complete.
The third part () = something not yet complete.
Tertian sons () = derivatives.
She hid him three months () = what is full of time in which it did not appear... Three = what is full, or an entire period from beginning to end... Hence from three months = a new state.
Let us go a way of three days () = a state quite removed from falsities; for three days = a full state. AC 2457.
(Thick darkness) for three days () = a full state; (by which) is meant an entire state from beginning to end...
Tertian leaders () = generals under which are particulars; for three, from which is derived tertian, = what is complete and entire. AC 8276, Explained.
They went three days in the wilderness and found no waters () = that truths were deficient, and at last wholly so.
In the third month () = fullness of state... Three, and third = what is complete.
For the third day () = plenary preparation... For the third day = a full state.
In the third day () = at the end of the purification.
Upon the thirds and upon the fourths () = in a long series and conjunction; for three = what is full from beginning to end; thus that which is in a long series.
Three years and six months () = to what is full.
Three times in the year () = a full state even to the end; for three = what is full from beginning to end.
Three times in the year () = what is complete and continuous.
The three things in speech.
Three = what is full.
Three reeds of the candlestick (on each side of it) () = what is full as to good and truth.
Three almond-shaped bowls () = what is full as to the scientifics from good.
Three times repeated = everything; in the internal sense, plenary conjunction; for three = what is plenary.
The height three cubits () = what is full as to degrees.
Their pillars three, and their bases three () = the goods and derivative truths which support fully; for three = what is full.

Why the Spiritual Kingdom is distinguished into three degrees... In order that anything may be perfect, it must be distinguished into three degrees... There are three Heavens, and consequently three degrees of goods and truths there. Moreover, each Heaven is distinguished into three degrees... and also the interiors of man; and each one of these is also distinguished into three degrees... The reason is that everywhere there must be end, cause, and effect... for a Thing to be perfect. Hence it is that three, in the Word, = what is complete from beginning to end. This is why the garments of holiness were the ephod, the robe, and the tunic...
Three = perfection.
The third day = a new state.

The ternary number also = an entire period from beginning to end, and thence what is full; but with this difference, that seven is mentioned where it treats of holy things; and three, where it treats of anything whatever. AE 20.
Under Six, see this reference.

Upon the thirds and upon the fourths () = the damnation of falsities and of the derivative evils... Three is predicated of truths, or of falsities... The numbers three, six, and twelve belong to the spiritual class... By three is also signified all truth in the complex.
He who thinks three, and says one, is at once detected.

In every Divine work there is a first, a middle, and a last... These three may be called end, cause, and effect; also Esse, Fieri, and Existere... It is from this that by three, in the Word, is meant what is complete and perfect, and also all together. Illustrated.
The third part = all.
On the third day after the heart has ceased to beat... they enter the Spiritual World. TCR 138.
Three = all as to truth. AR 315. AR 348.
Three, and six are said of truths, and = them.
To visit iniquity upon the tertians and the quartans ().
The third part () = all as to truth; for three = all, full, and altogether; hence a third, which is a third part, = the like. AE 506, Explained, Illustrated.
The third part () = all. AE 512.
The third part () = all these. ( = everything. AE 513. AE 514.)
The third part () = all things. AR 410, AE 518. AE 520.
The third part () = all. AE 525. AE 526. AE 527.
The third part () = all. AE 572.
The third part () = all who are in these falsities. AE 579.
1260 = the same as three and a half. AR 491. AE 636.

Three days and a half () = to the end and the beginning, that is, to the end of the Church which still is, and to the beginning of the New one; (for) three = what is complete even to the end; and a half = a beginning. The like is signified by three days and a half as by a week. Explained. AE 658, Explained. AR 510. AE 664. AE 761.
That three = what is complete, thus to the end. Illustrated.
Seven is said of holy Things; but three, of things not holy.
The third woe () = the final lamentation. AE 680.
I lay in bed (ill) three days and a half.
The third part () = all. AE 718.
Three unclean Spirits ()... Three = all; here, therefore, merely. AE 1000.
Made into three parts () = completely destroyed. ( = to be dissipated. AE 1019.)
The third thing is use. Explained.
Hence it is that three, in the Word, = what is complete, and altogether.
On the east three gates... ()... Three = all.
Three tiers on the orchestras there.
Ten persons prepared to be in Heaven for three days.
In the Spiritual World the third principle, which is the Natural, is lacking.
(Tricks to show that three are one, and one three.)

The three essentials of the Church: God, charity, and faith... Hence it is that there are three things in man as to his internal; namely, the soul or mind, the will, and the understanding. These three are receptacles of those three universals...
So there are three things in man as to his external... the body, the heart, and the lungs...
There are three things opposite to these universals: the devil, evil, and falsity. Explained.
Take whatever you like, whether animal, plant, or stone: these three universals, in some relation, are inscribed on them.
I was let into the sublime idea that these Three are one, which idea cannot be described, being possible only in the other life...
Three, or three times = what is complete to the end.
The third part the most part.
The third part () = some in the Church.
Holy, named thrice, = what is most holy; because three, in the Word, = what is full, complete, and continuous. AE 315:22.
Three () = what is plenary; thus that truths had been completely destroyed.
Three is predicated of truths... and it then = what is full, thus also what is genuine. Hence three measures of barley () = the genuine truth of the Church.
The third part, in the Word, = all truth.
Three years () = a whole period or time, from beginning to end.
Where two or three are gathered together... (). Two is predicated of good, and three, of truth; consequently, two and three, of all who are in truths from good.
Three is predicated of truths, because it = all truths in the complex.
Three = what is full, and is said of truths.
There are three things which fully constitute and form every universal essential: the good of love, the truth from this good, and the derivative good of life. Representation.
There are three senses in the Word because there are three Heavens.
The three hours (from the sixth hour to the ninth hour when the Lord was crucified) = what is full, and altogether.
As woe is said three times, it = grievous lamentation; for three = what is complete to the end.
That three, in the Word, = what is full and complete, and thence an entire period, greater or less, from beginning to end. Illustrated. AE 532:6.
Three, in the Word, is predicated of truths... because three = fulness; and spiritual fulness is formed through truths. Illustrated.

The third part shall be left therein; yet I will lead the third part through the fire... and will prove them () = that something of truth would remain, but scarcely any genuine truth. The third part = the residual truths.

The third and fourth generation, or the sons, the thirds, and the fourths (; ) = all who are in falsities from evil; the third generation = those who are in falsities of evil... for three, in the opposite sense, = falsities.
The third day He shall rise again () = the plenary glorification of the Lord's Human.
Three days and three nights () = to the full.
Three times in a year () = constantly.
That Peter was asked three times () = the full time, from the beginning of the Church to its end...
Three is predicated of truths, and in the opposite of falsities.
There are three Heavens, and three Hells... I have seen three kinds of (infernals): the fiery, the black, and the pallid.
God. 6. 3. There are three things which follow in order: love, wisdom, and use.
Trinity. 8. 4. There are three who bear witness in Heaven...
From (the fact that the Angels of the three Heavens dwell in the regions of these three atmospheres) it may be noticed whence it is that three, in the Word, = what is complete.
Three coats of the brain... and three coats around the whole body...
This Union of Three is not possible otherwise than as it is in every man: soul, body, and proceeding. These three make one man.
